{{family name hatnote|[[Gao (surname)|Gao]]|lang=Chinese}}
'''Gao Yulan''' (born 3 October 1982 in [[Ruichang]], [[Jiujiang]], [[Jiangxi]]) is a female [[PR China|Chinese]] [[Rowing (sport)|rower]], who won silver medal in the [[Rowing at the 2008 Summer Olympics – Women's double sculls|Women's double sculls]] at the [[Rowing at the 2008 Summer Olympics|2008 Summer Olympics]]. Her race partner was [[Wu You]].

At the [[2012 Summer Olympics]], she and partner Zhang Yage did not qualify for the final.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.olympic.org/olympic-results/london-2012/rowing/pair-without-coxswain-2-w|title=London 2012 pair without coxswain 2 women - Olympic Rowing|date=3 June 2017|website=Olympic.org|accessdate=16 April 2018}}</ref>

==Records==
*2008 World Cup [[Lucerne]] – 1st W2-
